note: A deterministic, labelled demonstration fixture of the applicant help assistant. It was written for this demonstration against the published text it quotes; it is not a recording of a Muse answer and it is never presented as one.

citations.quote: Before you apply: choose the project that matches your work in the list of permit types. Have the parcel number and the address of the work ready, and check whether the type you chose asks for plans.

answer.text: Choose the project that matches your work in the list of permit types, and have the parcel number and the address of the work ready.

citations.quote: After you submit: keep the reference number the confirmation page gives you. Use it to track your application at any time.

answer.text: After you submit, keep the reference number the confirmation page gives you and use it to track your application at any time.
